checkGroups.label: Knowledge Index
checkGroups.description: Five rebuildable Index layers. The detailed output plan below owns their individual enablement.

checks.label: Core Search
checks.description: Keep full-text passages and extraction readiness visible for this run.

checks.label: Embeddings
checks.description: Refresh semantic retrieval only for eligible indexed text.

checks.label: Machine summaries
checks.description: Refresh Peak-owned summaries without writing Markdown.

checks.label: Tag coverage
checks.description: Check the user-metadata policy separately from machine AI tags.

checks.label: Tag density
checks.description: Find metadata that needs an owner-reviewed taxonomy decision.

checkGroups.label: Content health
checkGroups.description: Four owner-readable checks for note shape and source quality.

checks.label: Empty & incomplete
checks.description: Find notes with no meaningful content or a clearly unfinished body.

checks.label: Oversized notes
checks.description: Find sources that may need an owner-reviewed split.

checks.label: Properties & names
checks.description: Keep metadata and naming issues together until an explicit proposal exists.

checkGroups.label: Relationships & Communities
checkGroups.description: Eight structural facts and review signals across links, Communities, bridges and drift.

checks.label: Broken links
checks.description: Find exact references whose target cannot be resolved.

checks.label: Missing backlinks
checks.description: Find one-way references missing expected return context.

checks.label: Unconnected notes
checks.description: Find notes outside the current verified structure.

checks.label: Weakly connected notes
checks.description: Find notes whose current links provide little usable context.

checks.label: Island Communities
checks.description: Find knowledge regions disconnected from the rest of the Vault.

checks.label: Fragile bridges
checks.description: Find important regions connected through too few notes.

checks.label: Decaying bridges
checks.description: Find cross-Community connections losing current support.

checks.label: Recent drift
checks.description: Find recently changed notes moving away from their established region.

checkGroups.label: Reviewable follow-up
checkGroups.description: Two grouped owner paths: freshness decisions and recoverable readiness failures.

checks.label: Freshness & lifecycle
checks.description: Group stale Hubs, inactive folders and inactive Communities into owner decisions.

checks.label: Recovery readiness
checks.description: Retain parse and Index exceptions as retryable follow-up instead of hiding partial success.

scanOperations.label: Plan scan
scanOperations.description: Freeze the selected scope, affected context and approved routes before work begins.

scanOperations.label: Embedding refresh
scanOperations.description: Build vectors after full-text passages and chunks are ready.

scanOperations.label: File summaries
scanOperations.description: Refresh machine summaries used by Search and maintenance context.

scanOperations.label: AI Tags and entities
scanOperations.description: Generate rebuildable machine-only knowledge without editing Markdown or YAML.

scanOperations.label: Relationship discovery
scanOperations.description: Compare changed and known content for cited candidate relationships.

scanOperations.label: Semantic review
scanOperations.description: Retain or reject candidates against cited source and current history.

scanOperations.label: Community analysis
scanOperations.description: Compare Community identity, boundary drift and current graph evidence.

scanOperations.label: Hub & bridge analysis
scanOperations.description: Inspect central notes, stale Hubs and cross-Community bridge facts.

scanOperations.label: Proposal evidence
scanOperations.description: Generate review evidence that may support a later file proposal; this Run does not create or apply a writable diff.

scanOperations.label: Maintenance synthesis
scanOperations.description: Keep only follow-up with a real owner action.

choices.description: Reject this proposed change without editing the note.
